title: The Kobold Den
description: A designated Kobold Den has a Captain prepared to deal with you. Establish formal contact with the local community without mistaking one Den for the whole Kobold people.
description_completed: Formal contact has been established with the designated Kobold Den. Its political outcome remains unresolved.

dialogue.offer: You found our Den. I am its Captain. If the dark tower has business beneath these hills, speak it to me, not to every wandering kobold you trip over.
dialogue.ready_to_turn_in: Good. We know who stands before us, and you know who speaks for this Den. That is enough for a beginning.
dialogue.completed: The Den remembers you. What happens next will belong to this Den, not every kobold under the earth.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign

rewards.name: Record formal contact with the designated Kobold Den
